body.x: UJET unveiled a ‘Smart Electric Scooter’ at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

UJET has been reinventing electric mobility products for urban fans. At CES this year, UJET announced to celebrate the global launch of its first consumer product, Smart E-scooter. The product as a high-quality product such as innovative design and connectivity, attracted visitors’ attention. This is an interesting product for people who value lifestyle and travel.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
